tldr: 台股上演「黑色星期一」，盤中一度崩跌 2,694 點、終場重挫 1,568 點收 43,502 點，外資單日狂賣 938 億元創史上前段紀錄，五家券商下單系統因爆量塞車當機。
美股反彈、晶片股領漲，費半大漲逾 5%、美光飆近 10%，市場押注記憶體缺貨延續至 2028 年，台積電 ADR 升近 3%。
OpenAI 秘密遞交美國 IPO 申請，估值上看 1 兆美元，與 SpaceX、Anthropic 並列，掀起 AI 上市熱潮。
蘋果在 WWDC 端出醞釀已久的 AI 版 Siri，是 15 年來最大升級，並攜手 Google Gemini，惟歐盟與中國用戶暫無緣。
以色列與伊朗在川普喊話降溫後停止互擊，國際油價漲幅收斂，但以總理納坦雅胡警告衝突尚未結束。

items.title_zh: 台股黑色星期一崩跌 1,568 點 外資倒貨 938 億元
items.title_en: TAIEX Crashes 1,568 Points in "Black Monday," Foreigners Dump NT$93.8 Billion
items.summary_zh: 台股週一（6/8）遭血洗，盤中一度重挫 2,694 點，終場收 43,502.78 點、大跌 1,568.16 點，月線失而復得，成交量約 1.13 兆元。籌碼面上，外資單日大賣 938.51 億元，創台股史上第八大外資賣超金額並連三賣，砍出台積電逾 2 萬張，並將凱基金、富邦金等金融權值股倒貨給投信。此波下殺主因美股上週五重挫拖累，外資同步匯出資金，新台幣應聲重貶，市場恐慌情緒蔓延，個股全面回檔，惟尾盤買盤進場守住關鍵月線。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index collapsed on Monday (June 8), falling as much as 2,694 points intraday before paring losses to close down 1,568.16 points at 43,502.78, barely defending its monthly moving average. Turnover was NT$1.13 trillion. Foreign institutions sold a net NT$93.85 billion—the eighth-largest single-day foreign outflow in market history and a third straight session of selling—offloading over 20,000 lots of TSMC and dumping financial heavyweights like KGI Financial and Fubon Financial onto domestic investment trusts. The rout tracked Friday's sharp US selloff and triggered capital outflows that hammered the New Taiwan dollar.

items.title_zh: 台塑四寶 5 月營收年增逾兩成 南亞一枝獨秀站上 47 個月高點
items.title_en: Formosa Plastics Group's May Revenue Jumps Over 20%, Nan Ya Shines
items.summary_zh: 台塑四寶公布 5 月營收，四家公司單月合計 1,289.46 億元，年增 21.6%、月減 7.7%；前五月累計 6,228.9 億元，年增 7.1%。其中南亞受惠電子材料需求強勁，5 月營收一枝獨秀，站上 47 個月高點。台塑、南亞看好第 2 季業績優於上季——台塑因中油新三輕恢復開車帶動產銷量增加、加上原油價格大漲，南亞則受惠電子材料營運佳；兩公司並研判第 3 季旺季表現更佳，油價下檔有撐，為塑化族群後市增添想像空間。
items.summary_en: The four Formosa Plastics Group companies posted combined May revenue of NT$128.95 billion, up 21.6% year-on-year though down 7.7% from April; cumulative five-month revenue reached NT$622.89 billion, up 7.1%. Nan Ya stood out, hitting a 47-month high on robust electronic-materials demand. Management at Formosa Plastics and Nan Ya guided that second-quarter sales should grow significantly over the first quarter—Formosa benefiting from CPC's restarted naphtha cracker lifting output and rising crude prices, Nan Ya from strong electronic-materials operations—with the third-quarter peak season expected to be even better and oil prices offering downside support.

items.title_zh: 四大代工廠寫最旺 5 月 伺服器出貨熱 法人看好下半年續強
items.title_en: Top Four ODMs Post Best-Ever May on AI Server Shipments
items.summary_zh: 廣達、緯創、緯穎、英業達 5 月業績都是歷年最旺 5 月，反映 AI 伺服器出貨暢旺。廣達 5 月營收 3,114.81 億元、年增近一倍，累計前五月 1.46 兆元，預期今年 AI 伺服器將占整體伺服器營收逾 8 成；緯創 5 月營收 2,901.83 億元，累計前五月 1.42 兆元，雙創歷史同期新高，強調 AI 伺服器業務將持續向上。展望後市，隨輝達既有 GB 系列 AI 伺服器持續出貨、最新 Vera Rubin 平台開始量產，法人看好相關供應鏈下半年動能延續。
items.summary_en: Contract manufacturers Quanta, Wistron, Wiwynn and Inventec all reported their strongest-ever May revenues, reflecting booming AI server shipments. Quanta's May revenue hit NT$311.48 billion, nearly doubling year-on-year, with cumulative five-month revenue of NT$1.46 trillion; it expects AI servers to account for over 80% of total server revenue this year. Wistron posted NT$290.18 billion in May with five-month revenue of NT$1.42 trillion, both record highs for the period, and reiterated its AI server business will keep trending upward. Analysts see momentum continuing into the second half as Nvidia's GB-series ships steadily and the new Vera Rubin platform enters mass production.

items.title_zh: 國巨 5 月營收年增 7% 創新高 AI 需求火熱
items.title_en: Yageo's May Revenue Climbs 7% to Record on AI Demand
items.summary_zh: 被動元件大廠國巨 5 月營收年增 7%、創歷史新高，受惠 AI 相關應用需求火熱，FactSet 最新調查並將其 EPS 預估上修至 17.73 元、目標價 950 元。公司預期下半年動能將逐步增溫，AI 基礎建設投資帶動 MLCC 等被動元件需求——此一觀點亦呼應高盛點名 MLCC「週期剛開始」的看法。在週一大盤重挫之際，國巨亮眼營收為被動元件族群提供難得的撐盤題材，後續可觀察旺季拉貨與報價走勢能否延續。
items.summary_en: Passive-components maker Yageo reported May revenue grew 7% to a record high, driven by red-hot demand from AI-related applications, and FactSet's latest survey shows analysts raising its EPS estimate to NT$17.73 with a target price of NT$950. The company expects momentum to build progressively through the second half of the year as AI infrastructure spending lifts demand for MLCCs and other passive components—a theme echoed by Goldman Sachs, which flagged MLCCs as a cycle "just beginning." The upbeat guidance offered a rare bright spot amid Monday's broad market rout.

items.title_zh: 輝達結盟南韓三大咖推動 AI 資料中心 鴻海沾光
items.title_en: Nvidia Allies With Korea's Big Three for AI Data Centers; Foxconn Benefits
items.summary_zh: 輝達宣布與 SK 海力士、NAVER 及斗山集團合作，將在韓國推動 AI 資料中心建設並擴大採用輝達技術。此前鴻海甫與 SK 集團結盟，業界看好隨輝達與韓國巨頭合作深化，鴻海可望沾光。另伯恩斯坦（Bernstein）推估，輝達下一代 Vera Rubin NVL72 機櫃成本高達 910 萬美元，遠高於市場普遍預估的 800 萬美元，意味 AI 伺服器供應鏈及機櫃組裝系統整合廠的價值含量持續擴大，相關台廠後市拉貨動能值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Nvidia announced a partnership with SK Hynix, NAVER and Doosan Group to build AI data centers in South Korea and expand adoption of Nvidia technology. Coming shortly after Foxconn's own alliance with SK Group, the industry expects Foxconn to benefit from the deepening Nvidia-Korea ties. Separately, Bernstein estimates Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin NVL72 rack will cost as much as US$9.1 million—well above the market's roughly US$8 million estimate—a price tag that points to expanding value capture across the AI server supply chain and the system integrators that assemble these racks.

items.title_zh: 記憶體牛市未完 美光飆近 10% 缺貨估到 2028 年底
items.title_en: Memory Bull Market Roars On: Micron Soars Nearly 10%, Shortage Seen Lasting to 2028
items.summary_zh: 美光週一狂飆近 10%，帶動整體記憶體族群走高，分析師認為在 AI 浪潮下記憶體產業正進入全新階段，DRAM、NAND 缺貨估延續至 2028 年底。利多外溢台廠，FactSet 將南亞科 EPS 預估上修至 47.71 元、目標價調升 4.35% 至 360 元；大摩重返多頭，點名旺宏為投資首選並加碼華邦電。此波動能凸顯 AI 需求正重塑記憶體週期的長度與報價結構，惟亦有分析師示警 DRAM、NAND 價格觸頂時間可能提前，後市報價走勢仍須留意。
items.summary_en: Micron shares surged almost 10% on Monday, lifting the entire memory group, as analysts argued the AI wave has pushed the memory industry into a new phase, with DRAM and NAND shortages forecast to persist through end-2028. The optimism flows through to Taiwan's memory names; FactSet raised Nanya Technology's EPS estimate to NT$47.71 and lifted its target price 4.35% to NT$360. Morgan Stanley turned bullish again, naming Macronix a top pick and upgrading Winbond. The momentum underscores how AI-driven demand is reshaping the memory cycle's duration and pricing dynamics.

items.title_zh: 蘋果 AI 版 Siri 正式亮相 WWDC 端出 15 年最大升級
items.title_en: Apple Unveils AI Siri at WWDC—Biggest Overhaul in 15 Years
items.summary_zh: 蘋果於週二（6/8）WWDC 開發者大會正式公布 Apple Intelligence 在旗下裝置的三大實際應用，主角為醞釀已久的 AI 版 Siri，是 15 年來最大升級。蘋果與 Google Gemini 合作，實現第二代裝置端 Apple Intelligence 體驗，並選擇走實用路線、未強推 AI Agent，迎戰 ChatGPT 與 Gemini。值得注意的是，受法規限制，歐盟與中國用戶暫時無緣使用新功能；同步升級的「兒童安全」功能，則協助家長把關裝置使用，緩解孩子沉迷手機的疑慮。
items.summary_en: At its WWDC developer conference on Tuesday (June 8), Apple formally showcased three real-world applications of Apple Intelligence across its devices, headlined by the long-awaited AI-powered Siri—its biggest upgrade in 15 years. Apple partnered with Google Gemini to deliver a second-generation on-device Apple Intelligence experience, opting for a pragmatic, utility-focused path rather than chasing autonomous AI agents, as it squares off against ChatGPT and Gemini. Notably, EU and China users will not have immediate access to the new features amid regulatory constraints, while related child-safety controls were also enhanced to help parents manage device use.

items.title_zh: HVDC 題材升溫 台達電、光寶科啖 800VDC 大餅
items.title_en: HVDC Theme Heats Up: Delta and Lite-On Eye 800VDC Power Opportunity
items.summary_zh: 隨輝達下一代 GPU 集群（如 Kyber Ultra）將單機架功率推升至 600kW～660kW 驚人水準，傳統 415V/480V 三相交流配電架構因銅材重量失控、機架空間被電源嚴重擠壓而難以負荷，加速朝高壓直流（HVDC）與 800VDC 供電架構轉進。台廠電源供應龍頭台達電與光寶科可望掌握此一轉換商機，業界形容該趨勢分四階段推進。資料中心供電基礎建設往更高電壓演進，為綁定 AI 建置的電源元件與電源供應廠商開啟新一波成長動能。
items.summary_en: As Nvidia pushes next-generation GPU clusters such as Kyber Ultra to staggering rack power levels of 600–660kW, traditional 415V/480V three-phase AC distribution architecture is buckling under runaway copper weight and crowded rack space, accelerating a shift toward high-voltage DC (HVDC) and 800VDC power delivery. Taiwan power-supply leaders Delta Electronics and Lite-On Technology are positioned to capture this transition, which industry observers describe as advancing in four stages. The structural move toward higher-voltage data-center power infrastructure opens a fresh growth runway for power-component and power-supply makers tied to AI buildouts.

items.title_zh: 股災日 APP 大塞車 金管會盯五家出包券商
items.title_en: FSC Probes Five Brokerages After Trading Apps Jam in Market Rout
items.summary_zh: 台股「黑色星期一」（6/8），共五家證券商因系統無法負荷瞬間湧入的龐大流量，導致下單系統嚴重卡頓或無法登入，金管會證期局證實業者已辦理資安通報，並緊盯這五家出包券商。另一方面，面對市場恐慌蔓延，金管會強調台股基本面依舊穩健、信用交易結構健全，指出大跌前各項指標反映的是韌性而非系統性脆弱，意在安定市場信心。後續可觀察主管機關是否對券商系統量能與資安韌性提出強化要求。
items.summary_en: On Taiwan's "Black Monday" (June 8), five securities firms saw their order-entry systems suffer severe lag or login failures as their systems could not handle the sudden surge in traffic, the FSC's Securities and Futures Bureau confirmed, adding that the firms have filed information-security incident reports. The bureau is closely monitoring the five brokerages. Separately, the FSC sought to calm panic by stressing Taiwan's stock market fundamentals remain sound and its margin-trading credit structure is stable, noting indicators ahead of the plunge pointed to resilience rather than systemic fragility.

items.title_zh: 永豐金、玉山金前五月大賺 均創同期新高
items.title_en: SinoPac and E.Sun Post Record First-Five-Month Profits
items.summary_zh: 銀行型金控獲利亮眼，永豐金前五月稅後純益 202.9 億元、年增近一倍（約 96%），EPS 1.4 元，子行永豐銀獲利連六年創高；玉山金亦以 177.2 億元續寫同期新高。兩家金控 5 月單月獲利雖較 4 月降溫，但在放款、財管及證券業務支撐下，獲利仍維持成長。彰銀 5 月純益亦年增約三成，累計前五月稅前盈餘 107.12 億元、首度突破百億大關。整體顯示銀行核心放款與手續費收益穩健，財管動能為金控獲利重要支柱，後市可觀察市場震盪對財管手續費的影響。
items.summary_en: Bank-led financial holdings reported strong earnings: SinoPac Financial Holdings posted five-month after-tax net profit of NT$20.29 billion, nearly doubling year-on-year (up about 96%), with EPS of NT$1.4 and its banking unit notching a sixth straight year of record profit. E.Sun Financial likewise set a same-period high at NT$17.72 billion. Although both groups' single-month May profits cooled from April, earnings kept growing on the back of lending, wealth-management and securities businesses. Chang Hwa Bank also reported May profit up about 30% year-on-year, with cumulative pre-tax profit topping NT$10 billion for the first time.

items.title_zh: 迎戰金融「三高」 國泰投信張雍川：黑天鵝來襲資產要守得住
items.title_en: Cathay SITE's Chang Yung-Chuan: Amid the "Three Highs," Survive the Black Swans
items.summary_zh: 國泰投信總經理張雍川表示，當前市場正處「高利率、高通膨、高不確定性」三高新常態，台股今年表現雖亮眼，但投資不能只追求漲得快、賺得多，更要思考黑天鵝來襲時資產能否守住。他將近期全球震盪與台股劇烈修正定調為健康的「適度整理」而非泡沫破裂，強調「漲得快不如漲得久」，並看好第 4 季仍有表現空間。國泰投信並推出全球多元收益傘型基金，以主動、被動雙策略並進，鎖定債市機會，協助投資人在三高環境下兼顧攻守、強化資產防禦力。
items.summary_en: Cathay Securities Investment Trust president Chang Yung-Chuan said markets are now in a "three-high" new normal—high rates, high inflation, high uncertainty—and that while Taiwan equities have performed well this year, investing cannot chase only fast, large gains but must ensure assets can withstand black-swan shocks. He framed the recent global volatility and Taiwan's sharp correction as healthy "appropriate consolidation" rather than a bubble bursting, stressing "rising durably beats rising fast" and seeing scope for a fourth-quarter rebound. Cathay rolled out a global multi-asset income umbrella fund pairing active and passive strategies to capture bond-market opportunities in this environment.

items.title_zh: 千億 ETF 再添一檔 淨值衝新高、年配息逾 17%
items.title_en: NT$100 Billion ETF Club Gains a Member; Distribution Yield Tops 17%
items.summary_zh: 台灣大型 ETF 陣容再添一檔規模突破千億元的基金，淨值衝上新高，年化配息率逾 17%，凸顯即便股市震盪，市場對高息、收益型 ETF 產品的胃納依舊強勁。此一里程碑反映收益型 ETF 已成為台灣投資人財富管理組合的核心配置，持續將資金導入高股息與備兌（covered call）策略。對財富管理業者而言，該趨勢強化了客戶在高波動環境下尋求防禦性收益的需求，後續對兼具殖利率、規模與流動性的商品需求可望延續，惟亦須提醒客戶留意配息來源與淨值波動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's stable of mega ETFs welcomed another fund crossing the NT$100 billion mark, with its net value hitting a record high and an annualized distribution yield exceeding 17%—underscoring the enduring retail appetite for high-yield, income-oriented ETF products even amid a turbulent equity market. The milestone reflects how income ETFs have become a core building block in Taiwanese investors' wealth-management portfolios, channeling sustained inflows into dividend and covered-call strategies. For wealth managers, the trend reinforces demand for products that combine yield, scale and liquidity as clients seek defensive income amid heightened volatility.

items.title_zh: 三高族群可買外溢保單了
items.title_en: "Three-High" Health Groups Can Now Buy Spillover Insurance Policies
items.summary_zh: 保險業者開放「三高」（高血壓、高血糖、高血脂）族群投保外溢型保單，以保費折扣或擴大保障獎勵健康行為，這類客群過往較難承保。此舉擴大健康險商品的可及市場，也反映保險業在核保上更廣泛運用穿戴數據與健康管理誘因。就財富與保障規劃而言，這為顧問提供了替較高風險客戶建構防護網的新工具，可搭配新婚家庭等族群「六點不漏」的家庭財務安全規劃一併運用。後續可觀察外溢保單在三高族群的核保條件與保費定價，協助客戶在健康風險與保障成本間取得平衡。
items.summary_en: Insurers have opened the door for people with the "three highs"—high blood pressure, high blood sugar and high blood lipids—to purchase so-called spillover (incentive-based) policies that reward healthier behavior with premium discounts or expanded benefits, a segment previously hard for such applicants to access. The move broadens the addressable market for health-linked insurance products and reflects insurers' growing use of wearable data and health-management incentives in underwriting. For wealth and protection planning, it gives advisers a new tool to build protective nets for higher-risk clients, complementing broader family financial-security planning.

items.title_zh: 綜所稅退稅 635 億元分三批 創歷史次高
items.title_en: Individual Income-Tax Refunds Total NT$63.5 Billion in Three Batches
items.summary_zh: 114 年度（2025 申報年度）綜合所得稅結算申報已於 6 月 1 日截止，財政部初步統計全國申報退稅金額約 635 億元，較前一年度 672.04 億元減少約 37 億元，仍為歷史次高。退稅將分三批辦理，分別於今年 7 月 31 日、10 月 30 日及明年 1 月 20 日撥付；採帳戶直撥退稅者，於退稅日當天即可入帳，首批入帳對象最早受惠。納稅人可留意自身所屬批次與退稅方式，確認帳戶資訊正確以免影響撥款。
items.summary_en: The 2025 (Republic of China year 114) individual income-tax filing season closed on June 1, and the Ministry of Finance's preliminary tally puts nationwide refund amounts at about NT$63.5 billion, down roughly NT$3.7 billion from the prior year's NT$67.2 billion—the second-highest refund total on record. Refunds will be processed in three batches, scheduled for July 31 and October 30 this year and January 20 next year. Filers using direct bank-account crediting will receive their refunds on the refund date itself, with the earliest batch reaching those taxpayers first.

items.title_zh: 全體上市櫃公司應於 6 月底前完成 ESG 資訊揭露
items.title_en: All Listed Companies Must Complete ESG Disclosure by End-June
items.summary_zh: 金管會提醒，為落實永續資訊揭露品質，全體上市櫃公司應於今（2026）年 6 月底前完成 ESG（永續）資訊揭露，延續其提升永續報導品質的政策推進。此項要求屬主管機關「上市櫃公司永續發展行動方案」一環，顯示對企業非財務揭露標準持續收緊。未能如期或達品質要求者，恐面臨主管機關後續關注，凸顯隨台灣揭露制度向國際規範靠攏，企業在氣候與治理數據上的法遵負擔日益升高。建議發行人及早盤點資料、確認揭露完整性，避免逾期風險。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission reminded all listed (TWSE and TPEx) companies to complete this year's ESG (sustainability) information disclosure by the end of June 2026, reinforcing its push to raise the quality of sustainability reporting. The requirement is part of the regulator's broader sustainable-development action plan and signals continued tightening of corporate non-financial disclosure standards. Companies failing to meet the deadline or quality expectations may face regulatory follow-up, underscoring the rising compliance burden around climate and governance data as Taiwan aligns its disclosure regime with international norms.

items.title_zh: 台灣 5 月 CPI 衝 14 個月高達 2.2% 房租漲勢降溫
items.title_en: Taiwan's May CPI Hits 14-Month High at 2.2%, Housing-Rent Inflation Cools
items.summary_zh: 主計總處公布 5 月消費者物價指數年增 2.2%，創 14 個月新高，加油貴約 2 成、搭飛機貴約 1 成。副院長鄭麗君於行政院「因應中東衝突民生安定專案會議」後研判，此非輸入性通膨，主因去年油料費及蔬菜價格基期偏低。數據中，房租 CPI 年增率降至 1.76%、寫四年新低，顯示資金大量流向股市、建商有感降價下租金漲勢明顯降溫；惟營造工程物價總指數年增率擴大至 5.8%、近四年新高，反映營建成本壓力居高不下。整體物價結構分歧，後續通膨走勢仍受中東情勢與油價牽動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's May consumer price index rose 2.2% year-on-year, a 14-month high, with gasoline up about 20% and air fares up roughly 10%. Vice Premier Cheng Li-chun, after a cabinet meeting on Middle East contingencies, judged the increase was not imported inflation, attributing it mainly to a low base in fuel and vegetable prices a year earlier. Within the data, housing-rent CPI growth slowed to 1.76%—a four-year low—as ample capital flowed into equities and builders cut prices. Meanwhile, the construction-cost index jumped 5.8%, a near-four-year high, reflecting persistent building-cost pressures.

items.title_zh: 政院加碼交通運價補貼 計程車油價補助上限提高至 1.5 萬元
items.title_en: Cabinet Extends Transport-Fare Freeze and Boosts Taxi Fuel Subsidy
items.summary_zh: 行政院長卓榮泰表示，政府持續推行交通運價平穩措施。其中公路客運、國內船舶及國內航空票價凍漲再延三個月、前後合計六個月；計程車油價折讓補貼每車再加碼 9,000 元，使每車最高補助提高至 1.5 萬元。此一方案旨在緩解中東情勢牽動油價波動對民眾與業者的衝擊，反映在整體通膨衝上多月新高之際，政府力圖控制民生成本壓力。後續仍須觀察補貼延續性與財政負擔，以及國際油價走勢對運價平穩措施的影響。
items.summary_en: Premier Cho Jung-tai said the government will continue measures to stabilize transport fares amid elevated energy costs. Among them, the freeze on highway bus, domestic shipping and domestic air fares will be extended another three months—six months in total—while the taxi fuel-discount subsidy will be topped up by NT$9,000 per vehicle, raising the maximum subsidy to NT$15,000 per vehicle. The package aims to cushion households and operators from fuel-price volatility tied to Middle East tensions, reflecting Taipei's broader effort to contain cost-of-living pressures as headline inflation pushes to multi-month highs.

items.title_zh: 川普 10 萬美元 H-1B 簽證費遭法院否決 科技業鬆口氣
items.title_en: Court Strikes Down Trump's US$100,000 H-1B Visa Fee, Easing Tech Worries
items.summary_zh: 美國麻薩諸塞州聯邦地方法院法官裁定，總統川普去年推出、要求企業申請 H-1B 工作簽證時繳納 10 萬美元費用的政策違法，並撤銷相關規定。此裁決對科技業及仰賴海外高技術人才的企業是一大利多，業界先前警告該費用將大幅推升聘僱成本、阻礙取得全球工程人才。裁定移除美國科技雇主短期重大成本壓力，惟行政部門仍可能上訴，未來移民相關勞動成本仍存政策不確定性，跨國科技公司人才布局須持續關注後續發展。
items.summary_en: A federal district judge in Massachusetts ruled that the policy introduced by President Trump last year—requiring companies to pay a US$100,000 fee when applying for H-1B work visas—was unlawful, and revoked the regulation. The decision is a relief for the technology sector and companies that rely on highly skilled overseas talent, which had warned the fee would sharply raise hiring costs and impede access to global engineering talent. The ruling removes a significant near-term cost overhang for US tech employers, though the administration could appeal, leaving some policy uncertainty over future immigration-related labor costs.

items.title_zh: 美股反彈 費半漲逾 5% 台積電 ADR 升近 3%
items.title_en: US Stocks Rebound, Philadelphia Semiconductor Index Jumps Over 5%; TSMC ADR Up Near 3%
items.summary_zh: 美股週一（6/8）在上週五重挫後震盪回穩，資金重返 AI 與科技股、帶動那斯達克反彈。費城半導體指數大漲逾 5%，因輝達執行長黃仁勳鼓勵投資人把市場修正視為難得的買進機會、喊出「撿便宜好時機」，此一姿態被外媒比擬為科技版巴菲特；台積電 ADR 升近 3%。黃仁勳並公開稱讚高通行動晶片市場表現、直接喊話投資人「買他們的股票」，帶動高通盤後上漲約 2%。此波反彈為台股提供跌深反彈想像，惟市場是否轉為趨勢仍待觀察籌碼與基本面。
items.summary_en: US equities stabilized on Monday (June 8) after Friday's sharp selloff, with capital flowing back into AI and technology names and lifting the Nasdaq. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged more than 5% after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang encouraged investors to treat the market correction as a rare buying opportunity—"a good time to bargain hunt"—a stance that drew comparisons to Warren Buffett. TSMC's ADR rose nearly 3%. Huang also publicly praised Qualcomm's mobile-chip performance and told investors to "buy their stock," sending Qualcomm up about 2% in late trading.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 拚史上最大 IPO 克瑞莫估市值上看 5 兆美元但有風險
items.title_en: SpaceX Eyes Record IPO; Cramer Sees Possible US$5 Trillion Valuation Amid Risks
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 將以 1.77 兆美元估值、750 億美元募資規模在那斯達克掛牌，創史上最大 IPO 紀錄。CNBC 的 Jim Cramer 預測市值可能衝上 5 兆美元、潛在上漲空間達 180%，但分析指出流通股僅約 4.2%、市銷率高達 92 倍，恐加劇市場波動，甚至外溢至亞馬遜等個股。這場巨型掛牌緊接在 OpenAI 秘密遞件 IPO 之後登場，體現資金追逐 AI 與太空題材的狂熱。市場對高估值、低流通的結構風險須保持戒心，掛牌後表現將牽動相關概念股情緒。
items.summary_en: SpaceX is set to list on Nasdaq at a US$1.77 trillion valuation, raising US$75 billion in what would be the largest IPO in history. CNBC's Jim Cramer predicts the market cap could climb to US$5 trillion, implying up to 180% upside, but analysts caution that with only about 4.2% of shares in free float and a price-to-sales ratio as high as 92 times, the listing could amplify market volatility and even ripple into names like Amazon. The mega-debut—landing days after OpenAI's confidential IPO filing—epitomizes the frenzy of capital chasing AI and space ventures.

items.title_zh: 以伊衝突油價一度飆逾 3% 川普稱雙方有意立即停火
items.title_en: Iran-Israel Clashes Spike Oil Over 3%, but Trump Says Ceasefire in Sight
items.summary_zh: 國際油價週一（6/8）震盪走高，盤中一度大漲逾 3～4%，因以色列與伊朗再度交火，引發市場對中東情勢升溫及停火破局的擔憂。在美國總統川普表示雙方有意立即達成停火、最終和平協議談判仍進行中後，漲幅收斂；惟川普警告任何「無知或愚蠢」舉動都可能干擾進展。伊朗外交部稍後表示已停止對以色列的軍事行動，但警告若以軍持續在黎巴嫩展開行動，德黑蘭將恢復回應，顯示停火前景仍脆弱、油價後續仍受地緣風險牽動。
items.summary_en: Oil prices swung higher on Monday (June 8), at one point jumping more than 3–4% as Israel and Iran exchanged fire again, stoking fears of renewed Middle East escalation and a collapse of the ceasefire. Gains pared after President Trump said both sides intended to reach an immediate ceasefire, with talks on a final peace deal still ongoing—though he warned any "ignorant or stupid" act could derail progress. Iran's foreign ministry later said it had halted military operations against Israel but warned it would resume if Israeli forces continued operations in Lebanon, leaving the truce fragile.

items.title_zh: 花旗下修金價短線目標至 4000 美元 高油價與升息風險夾擊
items.title_en: Citi Cuts Near-Term Gold Target to US$4,000 on Oil and Rate-Hike Risks
items.summary_zh: 花旗將黃金短線目標價下修至每盎司 4,000 美元，理由是高油價與升息風險雙重夾擊。此調降反映總經背景轉變——油價走堅推升通膨，市場同時反映 Fed 可能緊縮政策，兩者皆對不孳息的黃金不利。另高盛示警金價衝上 6,000 美元面臨重大阻力、白銀難大幅跑贏黃金，並點名因中東供應受擾的鋁，看好有機會挑戰更高價位，顯示原物料偏好出現輪動。投資人配置貴金屬與工業金屬時，須留意油價、利率與地緣供應三大變數交互影響。
items.summary_en: Citi lowered its short-term gold price target to US$4,000 an ounce, citing the dual pressures of high oil prices and the risk of interest-rate hikes. The downgrade reflects a shifting macro backdrop in which firmer energy costs feed inflation while markets price the possibility of tighter Fed policy—both headwinds for non-yielding bullion. Separately, Goldman Sachs flagged that gold faces major resistance near US$6,000 and that silver is unlikely to meaningfully outperform gold, while pointing to aluminum—buoyed by Middle East supply disruptions—as having room to test higher levels, signaling a rotation in commodity preferences.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 秘密遞交 IPO 申請
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已秘密向美國申請首次公開發行，時點落在 SpaceX 即將掛牌前數日、Anthropic 揭露秘密遞件後一週。此舉顯示在投資人積極尋求 AI 投資機會之際，AI 產業正掀起新一波上市熱潮。不過 OpenAI 也透露，因有些事在私人公司階段較容易進行，掛牌可能還需一段時間。
items.summary_en: **OpenAI confidentially files for IPO, prepping Wall Street for mega AI debut** (2026-06-09) — OpenAI has confidentially filed for a US IPO, landing just days before SpaceX is set to go public and a week after Anthropic disclosed its own confidential SEC filing. The move signals the AI sector's rush toward public markets as investors hunt for AI exposure, though the company suggested a listing may take time given things it wants to accomplish that are easier as a private company.

items.title_zh: 晶片股領軍美股反彈
items.summary_zh: 晶片股領漲帶動美股反彈，那斯達克在上週五重挫後收高。蘋果發表 AI 強化版 Siri，加上市場對 SpaceX IPO「掛牌跳漲」的熱議，進一步推升樂觀氣氛，半導體類股在 AI 與科技股買盤回籠下收復部分失土。
items.summary_en: **Chip Stocks Lead a Market Rebound** (2026-06-09) — Chip stocks spearheaded a market rebound, helping the Nasdaq close higher after Friday's selloff. Apple's unveiling of an AI-enhanced Siri and buzz around SpaceX's IPO "pop" added to the upbeat tone, as semiconductor names recovered ground amid renewed appetite for AI and technology shares.

items.title_zh: 外資今年大舉拋售南韓股票
items.summary_zh: 儘管南韓股市今年締造創紀錄漲勢，外資仍拋售數十億美元的韓股。賣壓週一加劇，基準 Kospi 指數開盤一度暴跌逾 8%，即便它至今仍是全球表現最突出的市場之一，凸顯亞洲市場情緒可能急速反轉。
items.summary_en: **Foreign investors have dumped billions of dollars of Korean stocks this year despite record rally** (2026-06-08) — Foreign investors have offloaded billions of dollars of Korean equities this year even as the market staged a record rally. The selling intensified Monday as the benchmark Kospi plunged more than 8% at the open, despite being one of the world's standout performers so far—highlighting how quickly sentiment toward Asian markets can reverse.

items.title_zh: 納坦雅胡：與伊朗、真主黨之戰未結束
items.summary_zh: 以色列總理納坦雅胡表示，即便伊朗稱已停止攻擊，與伊朗及真主黨的戰爭仍未結束。伊朗與以色列週日晚間互擊，是自 4 月中美伊達成脆弱停火以來首度交火，凸顯停火協議依舊岌岌可危。
items.summary_en: **Netanyahu says war with Iran, Hezbollah isn't over after Tehran says it's halting strikes** (2026-06-09) — Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu said the war with Iran and Hezbollah is not over, even after Tehran said it was halting strikes. Iran and Israel traded strikes Sunday night for the first time since the US and Iran agreed to a fragile ceasefire in mid-April, underscoring how precarious the truce remains.

items.title_zh: 紐約聯準會調查：家庭財務憂慮創 2022 年 7 月以來新高
items.summary_zh: 紐約聯準會調查顯示，家庭對財務狀況的憂慮升至 2022 年 7 月以來最高。雖然該月度調查發現通膨展望大致不變，但對整體景氣的觀感惡化，反映消費者對經濟前景的焦慮升高。
items.summary_en: **Household worries over finances hit highest level since July 2022, New York Fed survey shows** (2026-06-09) — A New York Fed survey showed household worries over finances reached their highest level since July 2022. While the central bank's monthly survey found the inflation outlook mostly unchanged, the general perception of conditions deteriorated, pointing to rising consumer anxiety about the economic backdrop.

items.title_zh: 禮來次世代減重藥後期試驗亮眼 股價走高
items.summary_zh: 禮來（Eli Lilly）股價週一上漲，因其次世代減重藥的後期試驗結果令分析師印象深刻。正面數據強化禮來在快速成長的肥胖症用藥市場的競爭地位，投資人正密切追蹤各家次世代療法的療效與安全性數據。
items.summary_en: **Eli Lilly stock rises after late-stage trial of next-generation weight-loss drug** (2026-06-09) — Eli Lilly shares gained on Monday after a late-stage trial of its next-generation weight-loss drug impressed analysts. The positive readout reinforces Lilly's competitive position in the fast-growing obesity-drug market, where investors are closely tracking efficacy and safety data across rival next-generation therapies.

items.title_zh: 聯合聖保羅銀行出價 350 億美元收購西雅那銀行
items.summary_zh: 義大利聯合聖保羅銀行（Intesa）對西雅那銀行（Monte dei Paschi）提出 350 億美元收購案，使 Intesa 與 BPM 為爭奪這家本土對手的控制權而對壘，延續義大利銀行業的併購熱潮。彼此競逐的提案，凸顯歐洲銀行業整併壓力持續升高。
items.summary_en: **Intesa Bids $35 Billion for Monte dei Paschi** (2026-06-08) — Intesa Sanpaolo has made a US$35 billion bid for Monte dei Paschi, pitting Intesa and BPM against each other for control of their domestic rival and continuing a wave of dealmaking in Italy's banking industry. The competing approaches underscore intensifying consolidation pressure across European banks.

items.title_zh: 馬斯克：SpaceX 在太空建 AI 資料中心不需「魔法」
items.summary_zh: 馬斯克主張，在軌道上設置 AI 資料中心並非「超難解」的問題，反駁批評者認為建置軌道資料中心說來容易做來難的說法。在 AI 運算需求激增之際，這番言論為太空運算基礎建設的可行性與經濟性增添討論。
items.summary_en: **Elon Musk says SpaceX doesn't need 'magic' to put AI data centers up in space** (2026-06-09) — Elon Musk argued that placing AI data centers in orbit is not a "super hard problem" to solve, pushing back against critics who say building orbital data centers is far easier said than done. The comments add to debate over the feasibility and economics of space-based computing infrastructure as AI compute demand surges.
